summary: The recorded base reproduces all source-level parts of the issue and the prior production-dispatch counterexample. The exact candidate corrects BF16 scale dtype, desc_act-dependent TP allocation, and full w2 scale/zero loading through _weight_loader_impl. Candidate regression and independent CPU/gfx950 adversarial cases pass.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction of BF16 dtype, TP shape, direct full loader, and production full-table dispatch contracts; 5 failed and 2 passed.
Candidate regression through allocation, direct loader, and production _weight_loader_impl; 7 passed.
Independent rank-0/rank-1, desc_act on/off, scale/zero, BF16 allocation and production-dispatch cases on CPU and gfx950 GPU.

gpu_execution.evidence: Independent production-dispatch tensor copies and allocation assertions passed on AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950, with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2.

remaining_limitations: The prepared environment has one AMD gfx950 ROCm GPU; the issue reports NVIDIA CUDA and TP=2.
The reported model weights were unavailable, so full serving, CUDA Marlin kernel execution, semantic accuracy, and NaN-logit reproduction were not performed.
No native source changed in the candidate, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
